# Matthew Kerr

> Matthew Kerr is a Grand Rapids, Michigan digital marketer and indie AI/product
> builder. He manages a two-property portfolio at KMG Prestige and holds an
> active Michigan real estate license. He runs data-driven digital marketing and
> builds the marketing tools himself with AI — landing pages, analytics, and
> automation.

## About

- [Portfolio](https://matthewkerr.dev/): marketing results, the products he has built, skills and experience
- [Résumé (PDF)](https://matthewkerr.dev/assets/Matthew_Kerr_Marketing_Resume.pdf)

## Quick answers (as stated on the site)

- Based in Grand Rapids, Michigan (West Michigan); open to roles across Michigan and remote.
- Open to AI product, growth marketing, digital marketing, property and community marketing, and marketing manager roles.
- Skills: digital marketing (SEO, SEM, Meta and Google Ads), analytics (Google Analytics, PostHog, pixel tracking), brand and content, leasing and property marketing with LIHTC compliance, and AI-assisted building of marketing tools.
- Results: $11K+ in sales at a 4.08% conversion rate; a brand's Instagram grown to 15,000 followers; a product taken to 2,300+ monthly downloads across 42 published models.
- Contact: matthew@kerrandcompanyholdings.com

## Products he built

- [Outlier](https://outlier.host/): private, offline AI for your Mac
- [Crisp Video](https://crispvideo.app/): restore and upscale video offline on your Mac
- [Docket SEO](https://docketseo.app/): website audits that rank what to fix first
- [AdPlaybook](https://adplaybook.app/): ad copy within every platform's limits
- [Built by Kerr](https://builtbykerr.com/): websites and local SEO for Grand Rapids businesses
- [Kerr & Company](https://kerrandcompanyholdings.com/): the company behind these products
